programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅。觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊: 死亡追捕 #6
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時,米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇。傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出,而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時,更令人心跳加速、驚慌不已。

programme.title: 野火劫後 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望、人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況。本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #2
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #3
programme.desc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #4
programme.desc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #5
programme.desc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #9
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #10
programme.desc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島—一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #1
programme.desc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #2
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物。他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬。

programme.title: 重塑: 瑪麗蓮·夢露 #4
programme.desc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞。

programme.desc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結。即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車、車隊和搭檔車手的艱钜任務。

programme.title: 冰島: 海鸚保護區
programme.desc: 討人喜歡、被視為「滑稽」的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂。長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖。少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #1
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #2
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #2
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物。他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #3
programme.desc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅維克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食。他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長征於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #3
programme.desc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事。儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程。

programme.title: 恐龍效應
programme.desc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識。

programme.title: 發現號穿梭機的最後任務
programme.desc: 在發現號穿梭機開始最終航行前,先慶祝它非凡的過去。見證這個感情洋溢的任務,看看這架堅固但脆弱的穿梭機能否抵達首府華盛頓。

programme.title: 李古查摩美國行 #3
programme.desc: 約翰先約見演員戴安古利羅,一邊品嚐城裡最滋味的拉丁美食,一邊談論她作為移民、作家和社運人士的經歷。

programme.title: 李古查摩美國行 #4
programme.desc: 約翰約見著名演員米高班納,瞭解在中西部長大,同時仍試圖保留他的墨西哥文化是怎樣的一回事。

programme.title: 李古查摩美國行 #5
programme.desc: 約翰繼續旅程,拜訪嶄露頭角的跨性別雷鬼藝術家維蘭奴安蒂蘭奴,她用音樂和存在改變著遊戲的面貌和規則。

programme.title: 李古查摩美國行 #6
programme.desc: 約翰與洛杉磯地頭蟲喬治羅培茲一起開車前往洛杉磯東部開展他的旅程。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,瞭解這座高地農場「從產地到餐桌」的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事。接著,他前往朵拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦——他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 來到赫斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉。他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家。他們共同的願景是製作天然、以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術。他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果。

programme.title: 科技巨擎 #4
programme.desc: 每集一小時的紀錄片都使用罕見的檔案片段,並以人物的公眾形象及其業務提出基本而嚴肅的問題。

programme.title: 女神們 #2
programme.desc: 在荷裡活以「鐵蝴蝶」聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,瞭解這座高地農場「從產地到餐桌」的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事。接著,他前往朵拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦——他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #2
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長征於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #5
programme.desc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食。他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一。他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮台灣大蝦。

programme.title: 發現號穿梭機的最後任務
programme.desc: 在發現號穿梭機開始最終航行前,先慶祝它非凡的過去。見證這個感情洋溢的任務,看看這架堅固但脆弱的穿梭機能否抵達首府華盛頓。

programme.title: 太空災難 #1
programme.desc: 從最早的太空探索到人類最近的努力,永遠有著風險。不過對於將美國太空總署不可預測的技術和未經驗證的設計進行測試的先驅來說,危險性更大。

programme.title: 太空災難 #2
programme.desc: 這是太空探索中最具挑戰性和危險性的階段之一: 將太空船帶回地球。數十年來,美國太空總署和蘇聯工程師和設計師們致力製造能夠承受因重新進入大氣層而造成熱無可恕高溫和不可思議速度的機器。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
programme.desc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來。在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
programme.desc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆艾利斯——這位年輕執行長是「相對論太空公司」的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
programme.desc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神祕的藝術作品之一——詹姆斯特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉。在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化。歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
programme.desc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師。隨著深入瞭解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫。

programme.title: 女神們 #2
programme.desc: 在荷裡活以「鐵蝴蝶」聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽。

programme.title: 女神們 #3
programme.desc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片。

programme.title: 女神們 #4
programme.desc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音、令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈。

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #2
programme.desc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場。

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #3
programme.desc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員。馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像。

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution

programme.title: 排球少年!! 第一季 #6
programme.desc: 在對上青葉城西高中時,影山碰到他之前的隊友,並遭受一陣嘲笑,於是他發誓要獲勝。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #5
programme.desc: 揚言要將防風鈴納為己有的獅子頭連頭領兔耳山丁子前來踢館,賭上兩方存亡的單挑對決即將揭開序幕。櫻一行人被帶入兔耳山等人的基地,一間通稱為「檻」的荒廢電影院。在被對手包圍下,有如置身牢籠之中,同樣以力量見長的杉下及有馬雪成的第一戰就此開始。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #6
programme.desc: 獅子頭連在團員敗北後直接開除的異樣光景,讓櫻等人感到動搖。但隨著難得顯露情緒的蘇枋獲勝,防風鈴正逐步邁向勝利。第三戰由防風鈴四天王的柊對上佐狐浩太,兩人之間似乎有著謎樣的過去。柊一開始面對敏捷的對手採取守勢,但也逐漸展現出武神應有的實力。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #4
programme.desc: 與風獄龍狄札斯特洛瓦的戰鬥揭開了序幕。儘管面對第三位階的強敵,在緋紅的精心策畫與指揮下,米海爾等人於戰鬥中逐漸取得優勢。目睹如此戰況的拉格納,再次體認緋紅對於實現自己的目的非常重要。另外在王都塞雷斯別拉,操控時間的翼之王出現在費姆德王面前。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #5
programme.desc: 收到上級龍接連斷絕音信的消息,讓正逐步準備消滅王國的翼之王奧偍瑪蒂亞開始警覺到有未知勢力的存在。而緋紅則是一邊預測翼之血族的動向,控制著戰況,一邊安排好讓拉格納和奧偍瑪蒂亞在王都展開對戰。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #7
programme.desc: 終於來到副將戰,櫻與十龜的對決即將開始。想起「打架就是『對話』」這番話,除了面對強者的情緒高漲外,與十龜對峙的櫻,內心似乎還萌生不曾體驗過的感受。十龜展現出與平時緩慢舉動截然不同的敏捷身手,但他在得知一切的開端,高架橋下隧道裡的真相後…。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #6

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #7

programme.desc: 終於來到副將戰,櫻與十龜的對決即將開始。想起「打架就是『對話』」這番話,除了面對強者的情緒高漲外,與十龜對峙的櫻,內心似乎還萌生不曾體驗過的感受。十龜展現出與平時緩慢舉動截然不同的敏捷身手,但他在得知一切的開端,高架橋下隧道裡的真相後…。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-聖經中的《世界之最》

programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:三種人 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《美好的工作》。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德以河鮮美食聞名，更是華南主要的饅魚（白鱔）出口城市。鼎爺與阿譚來到順德府右市場，果然發現順德饅魚肥美鮮嫩的原因。鼎爺還發揮烹飪絕學，僅以簡單配料即可煮出甘香味美的「煎焗大白鱔」，並會講解處理白鱔的秘技。炮製香滑的「蛋白杏仁茶」，「推蛋白」手勢固然要正宗，鼎爺竟提到當年需要用上女士的絲襪！另一款「花膠陳皮紅棗南北杏糖水」採用多種上乘食材，吃得夠潤夠矜貴，要煮出最佳口感還要嚴守放入材料的先後次序。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 糖上癮是指對甜食產生強烈渴求，即使明知過量有害仍無法控制，每日建議攝取糖分是多少？過量攝取糖分會增加肥胖、糖尿病等風險，內分泌及糖尿科醫生詳析飲食上的「糖衣」陷阱，並教大家聰明減糖。新手媽媽較容易患上產後抑鬱，症狀包括長期情緒低落，甚至出現傷害自己的念頭，有哪些因素較大機會引致患病？精神科醫生提醒身邊人如何留意產婦有否出現異常，並帶來治療資訊。「睇餸食飯」，李文星師傅炮製一道「陳皮欖角煎龍躉球」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 長時間站立容易令人患上靜脈曲張，一雙絲襪就可預防？鄭衍峰與黃頌明及鄰組的蕭欣浩博士與朱智賢，分別就絲襪壓力、密度展開爭論。不妨聽專家講解普通絲襪與壓力襪的壓力值差異，再學做預防靜脈曲張小運動。另外，甚麼工作會增加患上腕管綜合症的風險？油漆含有揮發性有機物質，其中的芳香胺會增加膀胱癌風險。兩組分別挑選出髹油保護裝備，有人竟戴上「潛水裝備」？中醫師帶來有益關節的湯水；再看嘉賓大玩蒙眼揀豆遊戲。

programme.title: 陪著你走#9粵
programme.desc: 天從在公園看劇時正恆突然出現，回家向天從打探，天從坦言明白正恆對自己只是放不下責任。天從獨自離家，言重因聽到一切不敢聲張，靜靜跟隨。言重回家，自願替天從照顧導生。言重送回導生，擔心天從有意外主動陪伴。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 夏日炎炎，濱治提議舉行試膽大會，並邀請小丸子參加，小丸子一口答應，但小玉卻因患感冒未能同行。小丸子在電視上看過《福爾摩斯》後，立志成為偵探，並且成功替爺爺解開明信片寄件人之謎。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 路牌除了指示方向外，也蘊藏着本土文化設計的歷史。本集「Kids’ Notes」請來研究路牌的愛好者，分享箇中樂趣。嘉賓介紹一種越來越少在香港路牌上出現的「監獄體」字體，其由來確與監獄相關。他建議小朋友如想尋找這些路牌，可到沙田區多加探索。辨認時，要留意哪些細節？嘉賓與其他愛好者合作，致力將監獄體轉化成電腦文字，但拍攝路牌作參考資料時卻遇上不少困難。他更珍藏了一個舊式安全島燈箱，為房間帶來街道感覺。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 傳送門關閉，阿渡等人無法回到原來世界，須佐之男告訴他們還有一個方法，便是挑戰「不全部猜對就回不7」。眾人最終成功通關，回到原來世界後，除了巨大的炎上彈外，還發現所有人都在為自己打氣。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 西沙有新盤交樓，驗樓師發現，附送衣櫃沒固定好，牆身也有瑕疵，質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 日前，本地一場女子足球賽事引發執法爭議，場面混亂。有業主在自家花園安裝驅蛇器後，遭鄰居投訴音頻滋擾，雙方各執一詞；捉蛇專家評論相關效用。主題樂園的士站疑有「黑的」揀客及濫收車資，引起同業不滿，及後更爆發衝突。事主旅遊時受傷並接受簡單治療後，在旅遊保險公司客服的建議下回港做手術，索償時卻被告知僅能賠償「回港覆診費用」？《在家宴客60道菜》即將播出，龔嘉欣與肥媽、李家鼎再度合作任主持，自言廚藝有進步。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2723粵
programme.desc: 樹仁於玩遊戲時遇到態度惡劣的職員，對方不肯給予他應得的禮物。樹仁忍無可忍，遂表現兇惡，終令對方屈服，還得到額外獎品。原來樹仁眼部不適，遊戲過程中不慎觸動痛處而「單起眼」，因此面目更顯猙獰，令職員心生畏懼。樹仁發現「扮惡」可解決不少問題，遂樂此不疲，成功以惡制惡，替不少人「出頭」。然而，他似乎走火入魔，對家人亦惡形惡相，因而人見人怕。凌凌唯有設法提醒樹仁，希望他能「棄惡從善」……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#22粵PG
programme.desc: 前來拿貨的周雄把錢交給巴朗，同時認出了謝庭威是員警，蘭崖軍團和周雄雙方開始槍戰。警方循著槍聲沖進交易現場，希瓦為謝庭威擋槍。巴朗告訴周雄這是誤會，周雄讓巴朗自己處理家務事，把軍火搬上廂式貨車。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 平城罵隨歌沒稱帝野心，說出清鈺死亡真相刺激隨歌，父子劍拔弩張，一笑斥平城枉為人父。莊慎被追問下說出景珩是平城所殺，莊后不可置信；慕容仲得知慕容曜與莊慎謀反，打算負荊請罪；一笑擔心隨歌，原來隨歌就在門外

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 節目回到上海，凱恩與沛珈置身隱世居酒屋，獲帥哥老闆推介試吃橫隔膜、掌心的雞串燒，令她們也大膽起來！特別矜貴的燒提燈，口感有多「得意」？燒肉最怕麻煩，找爆肌店員幫你燒，賣點是乾式熟成肉，厚實又多汁。凱恩隨依婷到衝浪館學習基本動作，為的是可穿著西裝兼牽手「人氣」外籍教練一起室內衝浪，姐姐立即變得型格！玲玲率眾來到坐擁外灘景致的餐廳，享用專人拆肉的大閘蟹，以及考刀功的松鼠桂魚，不時不食，味蕾大滿足！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#22粵
programme.desc: 卓萬宣布啟燊與小由婚事，子君要把喜訊通知爾嫣並接她回家。達志拒收小由禮物，更指不會出席婚禮。啟燁開會，廷亨來到，表示日輝經營海砂生意，或可與他合作。日輝舉行慶祝會，啟燁斥爾熹反骨，卓萬與爾嫣因此大吵。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 日前，本地一場女子足球賽事引發執法爭議，場面混亂。有業主在自家花園安裝驅蛇器後，遭鄰居投訴音頻滋擾，雙方各執一詞；捉蛇專家評論相關效用。主題樂園的士站疑有「黑的」揀客及濫收車資，引起同業不滿，及後更爆發衝突。事主旅遊時受傷並接受簡單治療後，在旅遊保險公司客服的建議下回港做手術，索償時卻被告知僅能賠償「回港覆診費用」？《在家宴客60道菜》即將播出，龔嘉欣與肥媽、李家鼎再度合作任主持，自言廚藝有進步。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#16粵PG
programme.desc: 有義行為變得異常，眾懷疑有義正結交女朋友，有朋發現對方竟是明星Icy。雜誌報道有義是為生意而出賣肉體的「保險鴨」。有朋看到有義與Icy進酒店，咬定有義不知廉恥，不知Icy與蔡公子正舉行驚世記者會。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 令宜設計抓到殺王煜真兇，是區少夫人娘家的手下，十一娘帶二娘認清真相，二娘在大哥幫助下找區少夫人對質，將事情傳開；衛國公對開海禁一事態度放寬；徐太夫人希望十一娘能守護好徐家門庭，使她萌生退出仙綾閣之意。

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵
programme.desc: 阿姐預備好中式聖誕大餐，款待錢嘉樂、黃智雯、蝦頭、胡渭康與家族成員。嘉樂胡謅拆禮物日日子及聖誕紀念屈原都中招？智雯不停舉報同時不停被夾裝飾，六號「應記一功」！嘉樂玩「狼人」期間不停說「夢話」，到底他來自哪個陣營？劊子手投票意願與最終決定有所不同，造就難得的一次打和局面。嘉樂自稱曾拍戲雙腳裂骨，但晚上仍然到的士高跳舞，怎樣可做到？蝦頭描述在泰國為愛被追殺的經歷，阿姐卻只好奇她如何認識對方及分手原因！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#17粵
programme.desc: 溢滿感到孤獨，高慶令他明白友情的重要，更留下小龜陪伴他。網上出現電腦病毒，溢滿「搶救」家人的電腦，可惜遲來一步，令有義「中毒死機」。有義即遷怒溢滿令他與網友失去聯絡，但溢滿卻成為萬眾矚目的巨星。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#28粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘獲准續留仙綾閣，對令宜感激不已。羅大太太病危，同時楊姨娘也因病離世，二娘悲憤，重提十一娘當初逃婚之事，使令宜心生芥蒂。十一娘對令宜敞開心扉，二人終解開心結。丹陽故意派小蝶服侍曉蘭，激化二人矛盾。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德是漁米之鄉，河鮮尤其聞名。鼎爺偕同阿譚品嚐「無骨魚」，一魚三吃滋味非常。為了滿足拍檔「食過返尋味」的要求，鼎爺特意炮製「順德家鄉燜魽魚」。魽魚魚肉嫩滑，選購時有何須知？鼎爺把魽魚油炸之後，再於魚背淋上滾油，又是甚麼原因？鼎爺分享買南瓜心得，新疆與日本出產的品種分別有何特點？烹調「豉蒜南瓜燜豬肋條」期間，鼎爺刻意保留南瓜皮，提升菜式的甘香味。他還提醒觀眾注意南瓜的下鍋時間，避免豆豉掩蓋瓜香。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 視神經脊髓炎是中樞神經的疾病，由免疫系統引發為多，視力或會急劇下跌，反覆打嗝都有可能是警號？腦神經科專科醫生提到，這病主要會使用類固醇及血漿置換來醫治，長久還要附帶一些復康治療。家庭成員不同的生活習慣、對學習的態度等，難免會引起衝突，調解機構代表建議家長先撇除對子女的既有標籤，再學會適度放手。想避免親子衝突升級，有甚麼要避忌？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨示範一道賣相可吸引兒童的「脆紫菜黃金雙鮮炒飯」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 兒科病症五花八門，今集請來兒科醫生為大家進修有關知識。小朋友的牙齒意外脫落應如何保存？「仁醫」郭子豪及海俊傑的專業解釋連醫生都讚不絕口。若沒有輔助工具保存牙齒，如何是好？另外，接受母乳餵哺的嬰兒一星期排便一次屬正常嗎？亦聽醫生講解哪種水不宜用來沖泡奶粉。小朋友發高燒應助其降溫還是焗汗？賴慰玲與張振朗一組現分歧！醫生主張哪些相對溫和的處理方法？營養師亦會介紹一款有益腦部發展、增免疫力的米紙卷小食。

programme.title: 陪著你走#10粵
programme.desc: 天從向正恆提出分手；言重播放「愛是無所不能1」的影帶卻卡在機內。他外出修理時遇見天從，邀她同行。兩人到洪民浩的見面會，現場播放韓劇，言重為天從講解劇情。兩人來到加勁的麵檔，天從更令言重知道加勁心意……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐有新的連身裙穿，小丸子大呼不公平，後來更趁姐姐不在時拿來偷穿，結果兩姊妹吵起上來。小丸子去做收音機體操，期間認識到一名自稱忍者後裔的老婦，聽她說完之後，小丸子對忍者產生濃厚興趣。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵

programme.title: 陪著你走#10粵

programme.title: 陪著你走#11粵

programme.desc: 隨歌抓住莊慎並押他入宮向皇上認罪，莊慎終在一眾朝臣面前道出，十五年前他為了剷除先皇后清鈺，栽贓她為錦繡細作，並趁亂殺死了她。隨歌終為母沉冤得雪，元妃知道莊氏已失勢，心中積怨爆發，在絕望悲憤下殺了平城。

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 隨着女性經濟力量攀升，針對女性群的吃喝玩樂體驗應運而生。麥玲玲先與何依婷、林凱恩、何沛珈、劉曉昆結伴同遊上海，再會合吳若希、戴祖儀、游嘉欣玩轉深圳、廣州，以女性角度帶大家「尋歡作樂」，見識時下備受姊妹們追捧的潮流文化與玩意，探索網紅打卡美食和景點，迎接多個「第一次」！「姐姐們」組團北上嘗鮮，猛男烤肉、帥哥居酒屋、小鮮肉按摩店、硬核健身、一對一辣身舞、格鬥酒吧等非凡體驗，如何衝擊姐姐「底線」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#24粵PG
programme.desc: 子君覺卓萬的態度有所轉變，從啟燊口中，子君明白卓萬所謂支持其實是支持政府。小由感激啟燊沒有放棄查木水案，二人成真夫妻。達志把金魚送浩頤，小茹發現二人相好。木水突然回來，發現小由已嫁啟燊，誓要搶回小由。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一集有森美登場，對手有郭柏妍與林正峰，齊齊探討男士健康。洗肚臍會否導致肚痛？兩組都不認同此說法，森美更將肚臍歸入「無用的身體部位」！森美憑一人之力先贏一分，聽泌尿外科專科醫生講解洗肚臍的重要性，用甚麼去洗才是正確？再了解患小腸氣的原因以及風險因素。森美清楚理解前列腺用途，再贏一分。認清前列腺的相關病症，再選出最切合男士健康的內褲款式。另外，中醫師帶來一款男士進補湯水。原來雞子並無補腎作用？

programme.title: 陪著你走#11粵
programme.desc: 天從到新公司上班，言重到修理攤檔取錄影機和錄影帶，更覺一切已重新開始。何娜向天從介紹是「奀星」金秀玄助手，秀玄沒有回程的車錢，何娜將自己的八達嘟借給他。天從聽到影印機發出咇咇聲響，向言重求救……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#18粵
programme.desc: 亨利立志要習武，更推薦悅滿到印度學習瑜珈三年，有朋初反對，後來支持悅滿的決定。有朋及溢滿為訓練悅滿獨立作特訓，悅滿苦不堪言。悅滿明白有朋苦心，大表感動，更爆出原來那個瑜珈課程只是維期三星期而非三年。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#29粵普
programme.desc: 曉蘭被推下水險死，丹陽受驚難產，幸得十一娘幫助保母子平安。二娘在王家病重，後來喝過十一娘給的藥果真好轉，但在王劉氏面前還是裝著病弱以保平安。令宜和十一娘打算讓諭哥和諄哥一起讀書，太夫人對此表示反對。

programme.title: 季節限定 秋冬粵
programme.desc: 所謂「秋收冬藏」，四位主持今回前往二澳稻田，化身農夫體驗稻米秋收的過程。辛勞過後細嚼當造米飯，換來意想不到的滋味！三位年輕人轉眼走進家品咖啡店，一邊品味香濃咖啡，一邊檢視當季至潮的梳化與木製傢俱，感受家的溫暖。大埔栗子專賣店運用炒栗子機，炮製傳統風味的栗子，主持們一探究竟，還邀得「廚房男神」烹調多道補脾健胃的栗子美饌。辰哥哥化身暖男Oppa推介雪濃湯、醬油蒸雞等韓國滋補佳餚，讓隊員進補一番！

programme.title: 季節限定 秋冬粵
programme.desc: 馬鞍山鹿巢山以奇岩怪石著稱，主持們相約嘉賓朱智賢瀏覽石景奇觀，並向攝影達人請教拍照技巧。不少鮮花均可入饌，秋冬還是食用菊花的好時機！主持們偕同另一美女嘉賓陳庭欣，到訪主打鮮花料理的餐廳，品嚐賣相、味道俱佳的菊花宴。秋冬適宜野外露營，出發前切記攜帶合適裝備，四名主持在運動用品店有何發現？他們及後還深入農地，採摘「秋冬三補」蘿蔔、薑和竹蔗。今集還有湯水達人推介清熱潤肺、滋陰養血的「西洋菜吊片湯」。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師(完)
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 紅天機(完)
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Monet: Discovering the Seasons
programme.desc: As babies grow and change, so does the landscape around them. From fiery red leaves to falling snowflakes; from flowers in bloom to fireworks in July, every season of the year has its own magic just waiting to be discovered. BABY MONET takes little ones on a sight-and-sound-filled journey through spring, summer, fall and winter using puppet shows, images of nature, children, toys, and masterpieces by Claude Monet set to excerpts from composer Antonio Vivaldi's timeless "The Four Seasons."

programme.title: Casper the Friendly Ghost - Casper the Friendly Ghost Ep11 - EP111
programme.desc: Depressed by the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After unintentionally scaring several potential pals, Casper befriends two young children. They take him home, where Casper frightens their mother. Casper is again upset because he believes that he will always scare away his potential buddies. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Newton: All About Shapes
programme.desc: With the Dolittle, and other Baby programs under their belts, the tots who follow Julie Aigner-Clark's Baby Einstein series will sidle up to Baby Newton expecting a similar exploration of building blocks to brilliance, but this time there's a wrinkle or two. Animation makes its first appearance, and parents steeped in keep-it-simple culture may object to the springy "I Know My Shapes" song, a departure from classical-only video predecessors.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Forgiveness - EP110
programme.desc: In this episode, we will go on an expedition to the Planet of Forgiveness and learn that forgiveness is an act of love that helps us overcome anger and misunderstandings and that when we forgive we see things with more clarity. And most importantly, when we recognize our mistakes we realize the importance of asking for forgiveness through our hearts.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: One of the great Kung-fu film characters is "Beggar Su", a legendary Ching Dynasty figure who was also a member of the famous Ten Kwangtung Tigers. Little-known director Liu Shih-yu uses the best Kung-fu actors Shaw Studios had to offer to tell a rare, colorful, action-packed adventure, as Beggar Su and his brother train incessantly to defeat the brutally powerful thief called Centipede.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra

This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu serves his triad society loyally and tries to live a respectable life, but over time his good intentions lead him to an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP3
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP12
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP3
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP9
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP13
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP14
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP3
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP5
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP14
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP5
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP11
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Shades of Life - EP4
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP17
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP11
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP3
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

programme.title: 閻小妹第59集
programme.desc: 這是一座介於鄉村與都市間的迷你化、可愛化的小城鎮-東閰鎮。裡面住著許多東方傳說中的人物、妖怪以及擬人化的動物。故事主人翁閰小妹是東閰鎮鎮長的獨生女，就讀東閰國小三年級，班上有各式各樣的妖怪同學，還有一位來自西方的留學生迪米歐。迪米歐和閰小妹兩人成為一對有趣的搭檔，產生出許多好玩的趣事。在東閰鎮裡，每天可以認識許多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每個角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被發掘。閰小妹將帶領著迪米歐與同學們在東閰城裡一起學習、一起探險，也將引導觀眾，重新認識華人文化裡，最具奇幻魅力的異想世界。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1671集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第168集
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福。

programme.title: 人間佛學院第13集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: 青春進化論第64集
programme.desc: 在全球一片鼓勵創新創業的風潮下，台灣未來的發展要有競爭力，即需要不斷的創新，讓年輕人有更多機會實現想法及創意，不僅是在協助青年圓夢，更是在打造國家的未來。節目中創業者分享創業甘苦談，創業時面臨的心理掙扎，以及如何克服困難，堅持理想，繼續走下去。【青年創ya家】主持人曾寶儀打破傳統一問一答的制式訪問，以如同家人、朋友間的聊天談心，讓各種你想得到的、想不到的青年創ya家，拋開緊張與包袱，輕鬆自在地分享自己的「青春進化論」。

programme.desc: 這是一座介於鄉村與都市間的迷你化、可愛化的小城鎮-東閰鎮。裡面住著許多東方傳說中的人物、妖怪以及擬人化的動物。故事主人翁閰小妹是東閰鎮鎮長的獨生女，就讀東閰國小三年級，班上有各式各樣的妖怪同學，還有一位來自西方的留學生迪米歐。迪米歐和閰小妹兩人成為一對有趣的搭檔，產生出許多好玩的趣事。在東閰鎮裡，每天可以認識許多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每個角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被發掘。閰小妹將帶領著迪米歐與同學們在東閰城裡一起學習、一起探險，也將引導觀眾，重新認識華人文化裡，最具奇幻魅力的異想世界。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1672集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.desc: 為提倡親子共讀、快樂閱讀，全新打造專屬節目《烤箱讀書會》！日本國際兒童圖書評議會主席松居直先生說：「閱讀應該是一件快樂的事！」。不管大人或小孩，每個人都喜歡做有趣的事，如果能將閱­讀和有趣的事結合在一起，應該就能創造充滿趣味的閱讀經驗，在這個節目當中，將帶領小朋友動手做點心，利用烘焙時間，和他們共讀一本圖畫書，不僅分享故事，還有動聽的詩­歌，讓更多大小朋友透過電視，共同參與這個充滿樂趣又有益身心的閱讀活動。

programme.desc: 魔法使芙莉蓮與勇者欣梅爾等人一同經歷了10年的冒險，最終打倒魔王，替世界帶來了和平。芙莉蓮身為活了千年以上的精靈，她與欣梅爾等人約好再次相會後，便獨自踏上旅程。在那之後過了50年，芙莉蓮造訪欣梅爾的所在地，但她與50年前長得一模一樣，相較之下欣梅爾已經老去，早已時日無多。之後，芙莉蓮親眼見到過世的欣梅爾，深深體悟自己至今都沒有去「了解他人」，對此感到懊悔的她，決定「為了了解他人」而踏上旅程。

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第400集

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第3集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第401集
programme.desc: 台視60周年台慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的台灣女人，在台灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與台灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 大愛年度劇展-芳草碧連天第8集
programme.desc: 這是台灣三代女性傳承孝順的歷史縮影。 魏家三代女性的心路歷程，從第一代阿罔，在艱困的環境中，沒有失志，奮發面對生活的挑戰，孝順婆婆、支持丈夫及女兒，讓大家都能好好活下去，與人為善，救貧治病，深受四鄰親友敬仰的精神裡，影響著女兒高金英及孫女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他們傳承阿媽的腳步，走過時代洪流，與家人彼此扶持，以孝順回報阿媽和母親。杏芬在美國聽了「渡」的錄音帶把家人都度進慈濟

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第22集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第485集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 法譬如水第485集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 大愛年度劇展-芳草碧連天第8集
programme.desc: 這是台灣三代女性傳承孝順的歷史縮影。 魏家三代女性的心路歷程，從第一代阿罔，在艱困的環境中，沒有失志，奮發面對生活的挑戰，孝順婆婆、支持丈夫及女兒，讓大家都能好好活下去，與人為善，救貧治病，深受四鄰親友敬仰的精神裡，影響著女兒高金英及孫女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他們傳承阿媽的腳步，走過時代洪流，與家人彼此扶持，以孝順回報阿媽和母親。杏芬在美國聽了「渡」的錄音帶把家人都度進慈濟

programme.title: 365日日素第83集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透過簡單的烹調方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第492集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第510集
programme.desc: 《多謝款待》由渡邊杏主演，東出昌大、財前直見、原田泰造、木村綠子、近藤正臣等共同出演。該劇講述了主人公芽以子從大正年間直到第二次世界大戰結束的數十年間，以飽含心意的美食支持著身邊的人，並始終堅守對丈夫的愛的故事。

programme.title: 慈濟充滿愛第268集

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第136集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 法譬如水第485集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第24集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 妙博士的異想世界第24集
programme.desc: 節能減碳、保護環境，探索自然科學，妙博士邀請大家一起學習與實踐，如何在生活中愛護地球！破解流言、保育萬物，拯救地球危機，不能再等待！跟著妙博士，一起行動做環保，科學救地球！每個人小小一念心，就可能扭轉未來的命運！

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第11集
programme.desc: 關於「吃」，該怎麼吃得有智慧、吃出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解臺灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.title: 在愛之外第28集
programme.desc: 郭翠花(范宸菲_飾)從小是養女，努力工作勤勉賺錢，在遇見理想的婚姻對象後走入婚姻，隨著先生的房地產事業扶搖直上，累積了很多財富，成為董娘，隨著先生的事業越做越大，涉足的場所越來越複雜，先生開始出入賭場與歡場，進而有了外遇，並與婚外情的對象產下一女，但因房地產的崩盤與先生的經營不善，事業走下坡，終至公司解散，負債累累，就在同時，女主角郭翠花也是最後知道真相的人…然而她必須在先生喪志時設法生活下去，為了家與孩子靠著勞力重新站起來。

programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大馬慈濟情第698集
programme.desc: 節目內容為馬來西亞當地時事以及慈濟人的報導，透過這些具有啟發性的報導、愛的訊息，帶領觀眾深入人文道理，見證慈悲等人文知識，進一步帶領觀眾啟發善念，淨化人心。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 法譬如水第487集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 高僧傳第1542集

programme.title: 慈濟充滿愛第286集

programme.title: 大愛夜安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 人間菩提

programme.title: 大愛年度劇展-芳草碧連天第10集
programme.desc: 這是台灣三代女性傳承孝順的歷史縮影。 魏家三代女性的心路歷程，從第一代阿罔，在艱困的環境中，沒有失志，奮發面對生活的挑戰，孝順婆婆、支持丈夫及女兒，讓大家都能好好活下去，與人為善，救貧治病，深受四鄰親友敬仰的精神裡，影響著女兒高金英及孫女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他們傳承阿媽的腳步，走過時代洪流，與家人彼此扶持，以孝順回報阿媽和母親。杏芬在美國聽了「渡」的錄音帶把家人都度進慈濟

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6709集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第511集
programme.desc: 《多謝款待》由渡邊杏主演，東出昌大、財前直見、原田泰造、木村綠子、近藤正臣等共同出演。該劇講述了主人公芽以子從大正年間直到第二次世界大戰結束的數十年間，以飽含心意的美食支持著身邊的人，並始終堅守對丈夫的愛的故事。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第699集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 法譬如水第487集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第34集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第597集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2108集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2109集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 護心第16集
programme.desc: 靈龍天曜懷著滿心喜悅準備和廣寒門掌門素影成親，誰知素影另有圖謀，她計畫取龍鱗制一件龍鱗鎧甲，為護她真正所愛之人不傷不死，卻不想天曜拼死在最後一刻將凝聚巨大靈力的護心鱗打出，素影大怒，將天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。護心鱗飛躍山河，落入了一心口缺失的棄嬰雁回胸膛，填補了雁回心臟缺失，讓她得以活命。十年後，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌門淩霄收養，納入辰星山成為他的弟子。因識海未開，靈力全無，仍是一星弟子，因此被同門嘲笑。一次偶然的機會，觸發了雁回心口護心鱗的力量，靈龍之火瞬間燒毀了鎖妖塔的結界，塔內的妖族趁機逃跑。淩霄得知後將其趕出辰星山，雁回誤解了師父，覺得道不同不相為謀，便瀟灑下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 護心第17集
programme.desc: 靈龍天曜懷著滿心喜悅準備和廣寒門掌門素影成親，誰知素影另有圖謀，她計畫取龍鱗制一件龍鱗鎧甲，為護她真正所愛之人不傷不死，卻不想天曜拼死在最後一刻將凝聚巨大靈力的護心鱗打出，素影大怒，將天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。護心鱗飛躍山河，落入了一心口缺失的棄嬰雁回胸膛，填補了雁回心臟缺失，讓她得以活命。十年後，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌門淩霄收養，納入辰星山成為他的弟子。因識海未開，靈力全無，仍是一星弟子，因此被同門嘲笑。一次偶然的機會，觸發了雁回心口護心鱗的力量，靈龍之火瞬間燒毀了鎖妖塔的結界，塔內的妖族趁機逃跑。淩霄得知後將其趕出辰星山，雁回誤解了師父，覺得道不同不相為謀，便瀟灑下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 包青天第187集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 包青天第189集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第15集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 公視手語新聞第11集

programme.title: 苦力第7集

programme.title: 行走TIT第246集
programme.desc: 台灣不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公視推出原鄉部落行腳節目《行走TIT》，用腳、用眼、用心行走，帶觀眾認識新台灣！首季探索十三個部落，挖掘罕為人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 恐龍女孩小丹2第13集
programme.desc: 小丹是九歲的小古生物學家，她有用不完的精力，熱愛恐龍的知識勝於一切。有一天在圖書館裡，她拿到崔克的恐龍圖鑑，發現自己竟然能看到真正的恐龍！還保護了禿頂龍寶寶，免得被覓食的霸王龍抓走。小丹經過改造的後背包，可以讓她變裝成各種恐龍的樣子，讓恐龍誤以為她也是同伴。

programme.title: 我家住海邊第8集
programme.desc: 《我家住海邊》名稱中的「家」，其實就是台灣，作為海島國家的子民，我們都住在海邊。《我家住海邊》是寫給大自然的一封情書，也是投遞給未來主人翁的瓶中信，藉由認識與紀錄八種「即將消失的傳統漁法」，看見身為海洋民族曾有的生活樣貌，及與大海相親相愛的故事。初衷在於傳播台灣迷人的海洋文化、海岸線、值得學習的漁人精神、漁村生活面貌與故事等給兒少朋友。節目海選九位小朋友，個別搭檔已為人父母、或者熱愛海洋的公眾人物—浩子、巴鈺、江宏傑、蔡昌憲、黃湘婷、旺福、魚丁糸小威、藍白拖，前往八個漁村，跟漁人生活兩天一夜。另外,透過節目延伸的線下VR體驗，讓更多下一代身歷其境感受海牛就走在身邊、討海人在船上有多晃…等，希望

programme.title: 大日子第1集
programme.desc: 基隆的下午難得豔陽高照，一對夫妻沿著港邊街道散步，看起來似乎是要一起去辦什麼事。他們邊走邊吵，吵架的主題從兒女的感情問題，一路延伸到兩人對彼此有多看不順眼，與其說在吵架，又很像老夫妻鬥嘴日常。途中他們在橋上偶遇老友，經過當年他們相愛、定情的天后宮，想起一些往事，話題漸漸惆悵了起來。後來他們走到了戶政事務所——原來他們是要來辦離婚的。剛才他們一起經過的地方，很可能再也不會一起經過了。
